extracted text: The material used in this study was an AA2524 Al-Cu-Mg aluminum alloy. The alloy ingot, which was subjected to a homogenizing annealing treatment at 495 °C for 24 h, was fabricated by the electromagnetic casting (EMC) process. The AA2524 T3 sheets were prepared by hot rolling from 22mm-6mm, cold rolling from 6mm-2.7mm, solution treated at 498 °C for 30 min, quenched in water, subjected to pre-deformation (3-10%) and aged naturally for more than 4 days.
